## 🚀 Feature Overview
A clear and concise description of the DevOps capability or usability enhancement you are proposing.

## 🎯 Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or developer friction? 
*Ex: "When managing microservices on multiple Linux hosts, I am frustrated because..."*

## 💡 Proposed Solution & User Workflow
Describe the solution you would like to see implemented:
1. User interacts with UI / Command Palette...
2. Application initiates action / remote SSH execution...
3. Result is presented in the dashboard...

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, third-party utilities, or workarounds you've explored.

## 📐 Mockups & Technical Considerations (Optional)
If applicable, provide ASCII diagrams, UI mockups, or specific Linux CLI / systemd / Docker commands required to support this feature.

## 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context or references about the feature request here.
